author: nickyeow

english.text: I remember meeting him in Paris.

jyutping: ngo5 gei3 dak1 hai2 baa1 lai4 gin3 gwo3 keoi5。
text: 我記得喺巴黎見過佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If a high hill stood between A and B, it was important to decide whether the line should climb over it, pierce it with a tunnel, or make a detour to avoid it.

jyutping: gaa2 cit3 A tung4 B zi1 gaan1 jau5 zo6 hou2 gou1 ge3 saan1，gam2 zau6 jiu3 nam2 haa2，tiu4 lou6 jing1 goi1 kwaa3 gwo3 zo6 saan1 aa1，cyun1 gwo3 zo6 saan1 aa1，ding6 hai6 zik6 zip3 dau1 gwo3 zo6 saan1 ne1？
text: 假設 A 同 B 之間有座好高嘅山，噉就要諗吓，條路應該跨過座山吖，穿過座山吖，定係直接兜過座山呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: She does not eat cake, so as not to put on any more weight.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 soeng2 hai6 gam2 fei4 lok6 heoi3，so2 ji5 mai6 gaai3 sik6 daan6 gou1 lo1。
text: 佢唔想係噉肥落去，所以咪戒食蛋糕囉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I sharpened a pencil with a knife.

jyutping: ngo5 lo2 baa2 dou1 lai4 paau4 zim1 zo2 zi1 jyun4 bat1。
text: 我攞把刀嚟刨尖咗支鉛筆。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Does he go to school by bus?

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 mai6 daap3 baa1 si6 faan1 hok6 gaa3？
text: 佢係咪搭巴士返學㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: How much do the carrots cost?

jyutping: di1 gam1 seon2 dim2 maai6 aa3？
text: 啲甘筍點賣呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you have a Twitter account?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 Twitter zoeng3 wu6 aa3？
text: 你有冇Twitter帳戶呀？

author: cc_neko

english.text: The washing machine is a great invention.

jyutping: sai2 ji1 gei1 hai6 go3 hou2 zing3 ge3 faat3 ming4。
text: 洗衣機係個好正嘅發明。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How much time did it take you to learn Chinese so well?

jyutping: nei5 di1 zung1 man4 hok6 zo2 gei2 noi6 sin1 hok6 dou3 gam3 hou2 gaa3？
text: 你啲中文學咗幾耐先學到咁好㗎？

author: kaenif

english.text: Don't waste time.

jyutping: m4 hou2 saai1 si4 gaan3。
text: 唔好嘥時間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Would you like another piece of cake?

jyutping: nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 do1 gau6 daan6 gou1 aa3？
text: 你要唔要多嚿蛋糕呀？

author: kaenif

english.text: I forgot that Cristina read English.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 Cristina duk6 gwo3 jing1 man2。
text: 我唔記得咗Cristina讀過英文。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The plane arrived exactly at nine.

jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 gau2 dim2 zung1 dou3。
text: 架飛機啱啱好九點鐘到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That's exactly what Tom wants.

jyutping: ni1 joeng6 zing3 zing3 zau6 hai6 aa3 Tom soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5。
text: 呢樣正正就係阿Tom想要嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Technically hiragana is a syllabary, not an alphabet.

jyutping: jim4 gaak3 lai4 gong2 ping4 gaa2 ming4 hai6 jat1 zung2 jam1 zit3 man4 zi6，m4 hai6 jat1 tou3 zi6 mou5。
text: 嚴格嚟講平假名係一種音節文字，唔係一套字母。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to take a nap.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hap1 jat1 zan6。
text: 我想瞌一陣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What makes you you and me me?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei5 hai6 nei5？dim2 gaai2 ngo5 hai6 ngo5？
text: 點解你係你？點解我係我？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you know what time it is?

jyutping: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 ji4 gaa1 gei2 do1 dim2 aa3？
text: 你知唔知而家幾多點呀？

author: aizilan

english.text: Awesome!

jyutping: sai1 lei6！
text: 犀利！

author: nickyeow

english.text: His body has never been discovered.
His body was never found.

jyutping: jat1 lou6 dou1 mou5 jan4 wan2 dou3 keoi5 ge3 si1 tai2。
text: 一路都冇人搵到佢嘅屍體。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They said that they're entirely self-taught.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 dei6 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 zi6 hok6 gaa3 wo5。
text: 佢哋話佢哋完全係自學㗎喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: May I trouble you to shut the window?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 maa4 faan4 nei5 saan1 zo2 go3 coeng1 keoi5 aa3？
text: 可唔可以麻煩你閂咗個窗佢呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Toast will always land butter-side down.

jyutping: do1 si2 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 caa4 zo2 ngau4 jau4 go2 bin6 zoek6 dei6。
text: 多士永遠都係搽咗牛油嗰便着地。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you consider yourself talkative?

jyutping: nei5 gok3 m4 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hai6 jat1 go3 do1 je5 gong2 ge3 jan2？
text: 你覺唔覺得自己係一個多嘢講嘅人？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Ziri was eating cookies.

jyutping: zi1 lei6 sik6 gan2 min6。
text: 之利食緊麵。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom and Mary both work at the same supermarket.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 tung4 maa5 lei6 hai2 tung4 jat1 gaan1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 zou6 je5。
text: 阿湯同瑪利喺同一間超級市場做嘢。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: There's a new iPhone coming out next month so I think that it's not such a bright idea to buy one now.

jyutping: haa6 go3 jyut6 jau5 san1 iPhone ceot1，ji4 gaa1 maai5 hou2 ci5 ban6 zo2 di1。
text: 下個月有新 iPhone 出，而家買好似笨咗啲。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom was holding a bloody knife in his hand when the police entered the room.

jyutping: baan1 caai1 lou2 jap6 fong4 go2 zan6，aa3 tong1 zaa1 zyu6 baa2 jim5 mun5 hyut3 ge3 dou1。
text: 班差佬入房嗰陣，阿湯揸住把染滿血嘅刀。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: I talked on the phone while working.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 zou6 je5 go2 zan6 gong2 zo2 din6 waa2。
text: 我喺做嘢嗰陣講咗電話。
